abstract: This paper develops a framework to evaluate the potential economic gains from deeper participation in global value chains (GVCs). The approach combines measures of revealed comparative advantage with estimates of value-added distribution along GVCs to identify opportunities for upgrading into higher–value-added production stages. It then quantifies the long-term economic effects of such upgrading using a structural gravity model. The framework is applied to Costa Rica’s electronics sector, a key focus of the country’s strategy to expand its role in the semiconductor value chain. The findings indicate that strengthening Costa Rica’s position within the electronics GVC could lead to substantial long-term increases in exports, output, and real wages.

abstract:
<jats:title>ABSTRACT</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Federally subsidized crop insurance is a cornerstone of U.S. farm risk management, yet policies with the greatest share of participation only trigger indemnities after losses exceed 15%. Supplemental insurance was introduced to cover part of this deductible, but participation remains largely unchanged. Using 1,005,245 sub‐county aggregated insurance observations and applying novel calibration and simulation methods, we show that low participation in supplemental coverage limits risk reduction potential. While basic insurance provides a foundation, adding supplemental policies meaningfully improves downside risk reduction and income transfer. Although these gains involve higher premiums, a benefit‐per‐premium analysis still favors broader use. These results reflect potential program impacts conditional on adoption, recognizing that actual participation depends on farmer preferences, risk perceptions, and institutional constraints.</jats:p>

abstract: We study participation in sponsored-search auctions when sellers can also appear as organic results. Under the platform’s ex post revenue-maximizing display rule, organic placement acts as an endogenous outside option: the best-matched sellers shade their bids and entry into bidding remains incomplete. The platform gains by committing to show more sponsored results than is ex post optimal, degrading match quality. Empirically, using Amazon search data and a Gini-based measure of query breadth, we confirm the model’s predictions: narrower queries receive fewer sponsored results, and sponsored results are worse matched than organic ones, especially for narrow queries.

abstract: We develop a theory of growth in which firms forage in idea space. A firm exploits a patch of related ideas, gradually exhausting opportunities for quality improvement, and then searches for a new patch. We cast this explore-exploit tradeoff as a tractable optimal-stopping problem and embed it in an endogenous-growth model. The composition of innovation — improving existing ideas versus discovering new ground — emerges as an equilibrium object. To construct an empirical representation of the idea space, we apply natural language processing to patent text data. The data support the theory’s central premises: returns to local exploitation diminish; firms stay longer on richer patches; and entry into new patches yields more and better patents. We calibrate the model to U.S. data and establish two results, on the composition of growth and on its pace. First, at a twenty-year horizon, patenting in new clusters accounts for over half of growth from quality improvements: sustained growth rests on firms continually entering new territory. Second, the model sign-identifies the origins of the productivity slowdown of the last four decades: exploitation spells have not shortened, weighing against worsening exploitation and tentatively pointing to harder exploration.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个增长理论，其中企业在创意空间中“觅食”。企业利用一组相互关联的创意，逐步耗尽质量改进的机会，然后寻找新的创意集群。我们将这种“探索-利用”权衡转化为一个可处理的最优停止问题，并将其嵌入内生增长模型中。创新的构成——改进现有创意与发现新领域——作为均衡结果出现。为了构建创意空间的实证表征，我们对专利文本数据应用了自然语言处理。数据支持该理论的核心前提：局部利用的回报递减；企业在更丰富的创意集群中停留更长时间；进入新集群能产生更多且更优质的专利。我们将模型校准至美国数据，并得出两个关于增长构成与增长节奏的结果。首先，在二十年的时间跨度内，新集群中的专利活动占质量改进所带来增长的半数以上：持续增长依赖于企业不断进入新领域。其次，该模型符号识别了过去四十年生产率放缓的根源：利用期并未缩短，这不利于利用效率恶化的假设，并初步指向探索难度加大。

abstract: Focus Historically, banks' holdings of sovereign debt have been key drivers of the co-movement between sovereign and bank risks. Recent years have seen an increase in banks' links with non-bank financial institutions (NBFIs) as well as a greater presence of NBFIs in sovereign debt markets. These developments have the potential to broaden the classical sovereign-bank nexus into a sovereign-bank-NBFI nexus. We examine the degree to which this has taken place, using European bank-level data along with global country-level data.

abstract: Credit constraints can limit land consolidation in developing economies, even when land rental markets are formally available. This paper studies China’s land management right mortgage lending pilot programme, which allows rural households to pledge land management rights—rather than land ownership—as collateral. Using household panel data from China’s National Fixed Observation Points from 2009 to 2019 and a difference-in-differences design, we find that the programme increases land renting-out by rural households. The effect is larger after the 2019 revision of the Rural Land Contract Law, which codified the use of land management rights as collateral and reduced legal uncertainty. The programme also changes the allocation of rented-out land: land is increasingly transferred to larger and more capitalized agricultural operators rather than to ordinary smallholders. Evidence on formal bank credit and village-level land rents is consistent with a collateral-value mechanism. The reform improves access to credit for households with greater scale potential and raises rental returns, strengthening incentives to supply land to the rental market. These findings show that legally secured land collateralization can facilitate land reallocation, but may also shift market power towards better-capitalized operators.

abstract: This paper takes the establishment of China’s data trading platforms as a quasi-natural experiment, and examines their impacts on corporate information disclosure quality based on the data of listed companies from 2012 to 2025. The empirical results show that the launch of data trading platforms significantly improves the quality of corporate information disclosure, which verifies the positive effect of data on corporate information disclosure. Such platforms exert influences mainly through three channels: encouraging firms to accumulate high-quality data, improving their capabilities for information disclosure, and strengthening their willingness to disclose information. Further analysis indicates that the improvement in information disclosure quality can effectively reduce abnormal audit fees and alleviate corporate financing constraints. This paper provides a data-oriented theoretical perspective for research on information disclosure quality, and offers practical implications for the construction of data trading platforms and the optimization of corporate information disclosure. abstract: Probably not, at least for meta-analyses in economics. In a pre-registered, identity-masked, within-paper experiment, the authors of 44 meta-analyses ranked three AI reports on their own paper by usefulness for improving it: a single pass by a frontier model against two multi-agent debate tools we built and expected to win. All reports were held to a common length and template. The authors preferred the single pass, by 0.66 rank points over mad-research (95% CI 0.32 to 1.00) and 0.57 over paper-workshop (0.16 to 0.95), though paper-workshop spent roughly thirty times the tokens. Authors who recalled their journal referee report usually placed it first and never last; in a separate exercise, three AI judges almost always placed the real journal referee report last. Among the three AI reports, Gemini (the judge whose model family wrote none of the reports) would have ranked paper-workshop first in the authors' place, reversing the single-pass preference. The reversal warns against substituting an AI judge for the author. We measure perceived usefulness for finished papers; whether AI should referee papers is a separate question.

abstract: We exploit China’s 2007 policy promoting the import of key equipment and technology as an exogenous shock and examine its effects on firms’ total factor productivity (TFP). Drawing on a merged dataset combining the Chinese Annual Survey of Industrial Firms and patent filings for the 2003–2009 period, we implement a difference-in-differences strategy to quantify the policy’s impact. We find that the policy led to a statistically and economically significant 1.11% increase in treated firms’ TFP relative to untreated firms during the sample period, and this result remains highly robust across a wide range of empirical checks. A mechanism analysis reveals that the policy primarily relaxes firms’ financial constraints and strengthen their capacity for innovation, especially technological innovation. These mechanistic channels contribute to an observed improvement in productivity. Moreover, the heterogeneity analysis indicates that the productivity effects of the policy are greater among medium and large-sized firms, state-owned and foreign firms, non-superstar firms and firms in financially underdeveloped regions.

abstract: This research consolidates three views of property tax incidence into a dynamic stochastic general equilibrium (DSGE) model and analyzes the effects of property tax shocks on housing markets. We show that the elasticity of substitution between residential housing (owner-occupied) and investment housing (non-owner-occupied) plays an important role for the incidence of the property tax. When applying the model to Taiwan’s housing tax reform, the results indicate that the implementation of a hoarding tax on investment housing fails to curb the investment housing price; the tax effect is passed on to the residential housing price when investment housing and residential housing are considered as complements. A tax on residential housing can effectively moderate residential housing consumption and residential housing prices.

abstract: Assessing land use and land cover dynamics in protected areas (PA) is fundamental to understanding how different conservation strategies influence outcomes across distinct territorial contexts. The present study provided one of the most comprehensive longitudinal assessments of the PAs under the Brazilian System of Nature Conservation Units, through geospatial statistical analysis of land use and cover variations between 1985 and 2022, drawing on an ad hoc Natural Cover Dynamics Index (NCDI). The results revealed persistent conversion of natural areas within Brazilian PAs, including strictly protected categories, with agricultural expansion emerging as the main driver of natural cover loss. Findings also indicated differences in conservation performance among PA categories, reinforcing broader theoretical and political debates around forest transition theory and land sparing versus land sharing strategies. Beyond providing large-scale empirical evidence on conservation outcomes in Brazil, the analytical framework developed in this study contributes to policy-oriented assessments aimed at improving strategic conservation planning and the effectiveness of protected area system. abstract: An unexpected increase in energy costs raises inflation directly through flexibly-set prices. Whether that shock amplifies to a larger and persistent rise in inflation depends on its transmission through the economy. This paper examines four channels of transmission of the Iran conflict to inflation in the EA, UK, and the US. The first is the transmission to the sticky prices in core sectors. Recent advances in menu cost models predict that inflation will rise faster than usual and monetary policy is less powerful to curb it. The second is transmission to spending, wages, and nominal returns through higher expected inflation. The empirical literature on household and firm inflation expectations points to some evidence for this amplification. The third channel is through other aggregate demand policies, especially fiscal policy. The IMF reassessments of the fiscal outlook provide some guarded grounds for optimism. The fourth mechanism is through an erosion in the credibility of the long-run inflation target. Data from market prices indicates that the inflation anchor has not moved. All combined, the data as of May 2026 suggests that the Iran war shock will have a significant impact on inflation that persists into 2027, but that is smaller and more short-lived than the 2021--24 inflation disaster.
abstract_zh: 能源成本的意外上升会通过灵活定价直接推高通胀。这种冲击是否会放大为更大规模且持续的通胀上升，取决于其在经济中的传导机制。本文考察了伊朗冲突对欧元区、英国和美国通胀的四种传导渠道。第一种是向核心部门粘性价格的传导。菜单成本模型的最新进展预测，通胀将以快于往常的速度上升，而货币政策抑制通胀的效果将减弱。第二种是通过更高的通胀预期向支出、工资和名义回报的传导。关于家庭和企业通胀预期的实证研究为这种放大效应提供了一定证据。第三种渠道是通过其他总需求政策，尤其是财政政策。国际货币基金组织对财政前景的重新评估为乐观情绪提供了审慎依据。第四种机制是通过侵蚀长期通胀目标的公信力。市场价格数据显示，通胀锚并未发生偏移。综合来看，截至2026年5月的数据表明，伊朗战争冲击将对通胀产生显著影响，并持续至2027年，但其影响程度小于2021-2024年的通胀灾难，且持续时间更短。

abstract: When Credit Suisse failed in March 2023, Swiss authorities, against market expectations, set aside the resolution plan and arranged a UBS takeover backed by public guarantees, sparing the bail-in bondholders who were next in line to absorb losses. This column traces how that choice reshaped investor beliefs about bail-in across Europe. Spreads on bail-in debt narrowed, the funding penalty on weaker banks shrank, and yields moved less on earnings news. Each points the same way: investors now see bail-in as less likely, a sign that its credibility has declined.
abstract_zh: 2023年3月瑞信倒闭时，瑞士当局违背市场预期，搁置处置计划并安排瑞银在公共担保支持下进行收购，使本应承担损失的保释债持有人得以幸免。本专栏追踪了这一选择如何重塑欧洲投资者对保释机制的信念。保释债利差收窄，弱势银行的融资惩罚缩小，收益率对盈利消息的反应减弱。这些现象均指向同一结论：投资者如今认为保释可能性降低，表明其可信度已然下降。
authors: Alessandro Di Stefano, Yvan Lengwiler, Kumar Rishabh
title: After Credit Suisse, markets find bail-in less credible
title_zh: 瑞信事件后，市场对内部纾困机制的信任度下降

abstract: US labour productivity has accelerated since 2022. Output per hour grew around 2.5% per year from the end of 2022 to the start of 2026, exceeding its pre-pandemic pace by 1 percentage point. A natural conjecture is that artificial intelligence has raised production efficiency. This column argues that the data suggest otherwise. Higher utilisation – that is, more intense use of labour and capital already in place – accounts for much of the recent acceleration. AI may have contributed to the higher utilisation rate, but through strong demand and heightened uncertainty rather than through efficiency.
abstract_zh: 自2022年以来，美国劳动生产率加速增长。从2022年底到2026年初，每小时产出年均增长约2.5%，较疫情前增速高出1个百分点。一个自然的猜想是人工智能提升了生产效率。但本专栏认为，数据表明情况并非如此。更高的利用率——即对现有劳动力和资本的更密集使用——是近期生产率加速的主要原因。人工智能可能对利用率提升有所贡献，但这是通过强劲需求和不确定性加剧实现的，而非通过效率提升。
authors: Shane Boyle, John Fernald, Huiyu Li
title: Higher utilisation explains the recent surge in productivity growth
title_zh: 更高的利用率解释了近期生产率增长的激增

abstract: How large is the labor cost saved by AI, and how is it distributed across occupations? Using five waves of the Anthropic Economic Index (January 2025 to February 2026), we construct two novel measures from observed AI usage across countries over the world. The AI concentration index (ACI) shows that in developing economies, virtually all AI usage-based value is generated in a small professional enclave (ACI near 1.0); high-income economies average 0.4 to 0.5, with concentration declining in many countries. The labor cost equivalent (LCE) values the time currently saved by AI at $2.7 trillion annually (3.4% of GDP), an indicative measure of the labor cost of that time. Income and regulatory readiness predict concentration; lacking an official English language slows broadening, a barrier for developing countries.
abstract_zh: 人工智能节省的劳动力成本规模有多大？这些成本在不同职业间如何分布？基于五轮Anthropic经济指数（2025年1月至2026年2月），我们利用全球各国观测到的AI使用情况构建了两个新颖的度量指标。AI集中度指数（ACI）显示，在发展中经济体，几乎所有基于AI使用的价值都产生于一个狭小的专业飞地（ACI接近1.0）；高收入经济体的ACI均值在0.4至0.5之间，且许多国家的集中度呈下降趋势。劳动力成本当量（LCE）将当前AI节省的时间价值评估为每年2.7万亿美元（占GDP的3.4%），这是对该时间所对应劳动力成本的一个指示性度量。收入水平与监管准备度可预测集中度；缺乏官方英语语言能力会阻碍AI应用的拓展，这对发展中国家构成了一道障碍。
authors: Rachel Yuting Fan & Ha Minh Nguyen
title: Aggregate Gains from AI and Their Distribution: Global Evidence from Usage Data
title_zh: 人工智能的总体收益及其分配：来自使用数据的全球证据

abstract: Understanding financial activity beyond traditional regulatory frameworks is essential for policymakers. Yet cryptocurrency mining—which offers a direct entry point into the crypto ecosystem without relying on traditional financial intermediaries—remains highly opaque. We propose a novel measurement approach using detailed customs data that tracks exports of crypto mining hardware from the world’s dominant producers. This trade-based proxy allows us to analyze the global distribution of mining hardware imports and identify their key drivers, guided by a stylized model. Empirically, mining surges respond strongly to global factors such as cryptocurrency prices and hardware costs, while domestic factors—including electricity prices and ambient temperature—shape the cross-country distribution of activity. Our findings highlight how global crypto markets, natural endowments, and policy choices jointly influence mining incentives, offering valuable insights for policymakers concerned with financial stability risks and energy subsidy misuse.
abstract_zh: 理解传统监管框架之外的金融活动对政策制定者至关重要。然而，加密货币挖矿——作为无需依赖传统金融中介即可直接进入加密生态系统的途径——仍然高度不透明。我们提出了一种新颖的测量方法，利用详细的关税数据追踪全球主要生产商出口的加密挖矿硬件。这一基于贸易的代理变量使我们能够分析挖矿硬件进口的全球分布，并借助一个简化模型识别其关键驱动因素。实证结果显示，挖矿活动激增对加密货币价格和硬件成本等全球因素反应强烈，而国内因素——包括电价和环境温度——则塑造了活动的跨国分布。我们的发现揭示了全球加密市场、自然禀赋和政策选择如何共同影响挖矿激励，为关注金融稳定风险和能源补贴滥用的政策制定者提供了宝贵见解。
authors: Andras Komaromi & Federico Grinberg & Mr. Diego A. Cerdeiro & Yang Liu

title: What Drives Crypto Mining? Evidence from Hardware Imports
title_zh: 什么驱动了加密货币挖矿？来自硬件进口的证据

abstract: This paper analyses U.S. secured repo spreads by jointly looking into reserves, dealer balance-sheet usage, hedge fund leverage, and Treasury issuance. Using a quantile regression framework, the results show that repo market dynamics are strongly state-dependent. Higher level of reserves consistently compress repo spreads to the Federal Reserve’s overninght reverse repo offering rate and remain the primary stabilizing force, particularly in tighter funding conditions. Hedge fund activity appears to amplify dealer balance-sheet pressures in lower quantiles, reflecting the impact of leveraged demand in normal markets. As spreads rise, this effect weakens. Instead, heavier Treasury issuance appears to weigh on repo spreads via its stronger effect on dealer balance sheet pressures. Overall, U.S. repo spreads are affected by the supply of central bank liquidity, demand for leverage, Treasury issuance and intermediary capacity. Crucially, these drivers are not equally relevant across the distribution of funding conditions.
abstract_zh: 本文通过联合考察准备金、交易商资产负债表使用情况、对冲基金杠杆率及国债发行，分析了美国有担保回购利差。基于分位数回归框架的研究结果表明，回购市场动态具有显著的状态依赖性。较高的准备金水平持续压缩回购利差至美联储隔夜逆回购利率，并始终是主要的稳定力量，尤其在融资条件趋紧时更为显著。对冲基金活动在较低分位数上会放大交易商资产负债表压力，反映出正常市场中杠杆需求的影响。随着利差上升，这一效应逐渐减弱。相反，国债发行增加通过加剧交易商资产负债表压力，对回购利差产生更大影响。总体而言，美国回购利差受到央行流动性供给、杠杆需求、国债发行及中介能力的共同影响。关键在于，这些驱动因素在融资条件分布的不同区间内并非同等重要。
title: Repo Rate Dynamics: The Role of Dealers, Hedge Funds, and Issuance
title_zh: 回购利率动态：交易商、对冲基金与发行量的作用

abstract: This paper studies how dollar stablecoins affect parallel foreign-exchange markets in economies with fixed or heavily managed exchange rates. When foreign currency is rationed, the true degree of exchange-rate misalignment is not directly observed. Traditional parallel markets reveal it only imperfectly because information is dispersed across bilateral and often private trading opportunities. Stablecoins make dollar-like claims easier to access outside the official allocation system, but they also create a visible, high-frequency price that aggregates order flow in a common venue. I develop a global-games model in which households observe dispersed private signals about misalignment, while stablecoin market depth determines the precision of a common public signal. Stablecoins generate a state-dependent welfare effect. They expand access to foreign-currency and can improve allocation by making beliefs about misalignment more informative, but the same public price can also coordinate runs by making beliefs and actions more synchronized. When misalignment is low, access and allocation gains dominate, so stablecoins raise welfare. When misalignment is high, the coordination externality becomes more costly: a more precise public signal compresses belief dispersion, strengthens coordinated exit incentives, and can overturn the access benefit. This points to a state-contingent approach that preserves low-cost access in normal states while using temporary, targeted measures to manage large or run-like flows when misalignment is high.
abstract_zh: 本文研究美元稳定币如何影响固定或严格管理汇率经济体中的平行外汇市场。当外币被配给时，汇率失衡的真实程度无法直接观测。传统平行市场仅能不完全揭示这一信息，因为信息分散于双边且往往私密的交易机会中。稳定币使得美元类债权更易在官方分配体系之外获取，但同时也创造了可见的高频价格，该价格在共同交易平台上汇聚订单流。我构建了一个全局博弈模型，其中家庭观测到关于汇率失衡的分散私人信号，而稳定币市场深度决定了共同公共信号的精确度。稳定币产生状态依赖的福利效应：它们扩大了外币获取渠道，并通过使关于失衡的信念更具信息量来改善资源配置，但同一公共价格也可能通过使信念与行动更趋同步而协调挤兑行为。当失衡程度较低时，获取渠道与资源配置的收益占主导地位，因此稳定币提升福利；当失衡程度较高时，协调外部性成本上升——更精确的公共信号压缩信念离散度，强化协调性退出激励，并可能抵消获取收益。这指向一种状态依存的应对方案：在正常状态下保留低成本获取渠道，同时在失衡严重时采用临时性、针对性的措施管理大规模或挤兑式资金流动。
title: Stablecoins and Fragility in Fixed Exchange Rate Regimes
title_zh: 稳定币与固定汇率制度中的脆弱性

abstract: Across much of the Middle East and Central Asia (ME&CA), market competition remains weaker than in other emerging markets, holding back productivity and income growth. Using firm-level data from Orbis for 2002–2021, this paper studies the evolution of market competition in ME&CA economies and examines how trade policy and institutions shape competitive dynamics. We find that market power remains substantial and uneven across ME&CA, with particularly high markups in resource-intensive activities, selected service sectors, and—more recently—manufacturing in the Caucasus and Central Asia (CCA). Higher tariff protection is systematically associated with faster growth in markups, indicating that trade barriers weaken competitive pressure, while improvements in competition policy, anti-corruption frameworks, and property rights are linked to declining market power and hence increasing competition. Although productivity gaps remain large and persistent, stronger competition is associated with faster firm-level productivity growth and higher GDP per capita growth, with these effects particularly pronounced in CCA economies. Overall, the findings highlight the importance of policies aimed at reducing trade barriers and strengthening institutional and competition policy frameworks to foster competition, raise productivity, and support long-term income growth in the ME&CA region.
abstract_zh: 在中东和中亚大部分地区，市场竞争仍弱于其他新兴市场，这抑制了生产率和收入增长。本文利用Orbis数据库2002-2021年的企业层面数据，研究中东和中亚经济体的市场竞争演变，并考察贸易政策和制度如何塑造竞争动态。我们发现，中东和中亚地区的市场势力依然显著且分布不均，资源密集型活动、部分服务业以及近期高加索和中亚地区的制造业中，加成率尤其偏高。更高的关税保护与加成率的更快增长系统性相关，表明贸易壁垒削弱了竞争压力；而竞争政策、反腐败框架和产权制度的改善则与市场势力下降（即竞争增强）相关联。尽管生产率差距依然巨大且持续存在，但更强的竞争与企业层面生产率的更快增长以及更高的人均GDP增长相关，这些效应在高加索和中亚经济体中尤为显著。总体而言，研究结果强调了旨在降低贸易壁垒、加强制度和竞争政策框架的政策重要性，以促进竞争、提高生产率并支持中东和中亚地区的长期收入增长。
authors: Walid Faris & Mr. Etibar Jafarov & Umang Rawat
china_relevance_reason: 研究对象为中东和中亚地区，数据来自Orbis，不涉及中国、香港或台湾
title: Competition and Productivity in Middle East and Central Asia: What Role Do Tariffs Play?
title_zh: 中东与中亚的竞争与生产率：关税扮演何种角色？

abstract: 健全与国际规则相衔接的知识产权保护机制是推进高水平制度型开放的重要内容。本文立足于我国《专利法》向TRIPS的三次协调这一规制开放的客观事实,使用广义双重差分模型考察知识产权规制开放对中国国际专利申请的影响。研究发现：《专利法》TRIPS协调通过同族专利挤出、专利意识强化及自主创新激励三条路径影响中国国际专利申请;1992年《专利法》TRIPS协调以同族专利挤出效应为主,整体阻碍国际专利申请,而2000和2008年《专利法》TRIPS协调,专利意识强化与自主创新激励效应显著,整体促进国际专利申请。在技术深度密集、贸易活跃度高、高技术价值以及高联合创新水平的行业和低专利集中度的目的地中,以上政策效果更为突出。此外,仅第三次协调对国际专利释放“提质”效应,但未实现“增效”目标。本文系统评估了我国《专利法》TRIPS协调的政策成效,为深入推进我国高水平制度型开放与实施创新驱动发展战略提供了政策启示。

abstract: 提升创业投资集聚程度是优化科技型中小企业融资环境,推进金融服务科技创新能力建设的关键举措。本文构建一个嵌入创业投资的内生增长模型,利用基金小镇设立的外生冲击分析创业投资集聚对企业创新的影响。研究发现,创业投资集聚能够改善研发资金配置效率,显著提升企业创新产出。机制分析表明,信息搜寻成本和委托代理成本下降是其激励企业创新的主要渠道,具体表现为在基金小镇设立后,被投资企业获取了充足的外部融资,创业投资机构参与企业内部治理的概率提升。进一步研究发现,地区营商环境是决定创业投资集聚外部性强弱的关键因素。本文研究结论为壮大耐心资本和因地制宜培育新质生产力提供了坚实的理论支撑和经验证据。

abstract: 当前中国经济正面临“内卷式”竞争加剧与全要素生产率增速放缓并存的结构性矛盾。为此,本文构建包含分步式创新与内生策略选择的熊彼特增长模型,结合典型事实,刻画企业在高质量创新、低质量微创新与掠夺性定价间的权衡,并通过数值模拟考察微观策略偏离导致宏观增长放缓的内在机理。研究发现,激烈的同质化竞争、缺乏梯度的产权保护与数量导向型的支持政策共同扭曲了创新激励,促使企业转向低成本微创新或价格战,挤出颠覆性技术突破,最终导致经济陷入高投入、低产出的“内卷陷阱”。拓展分析表明,信息不对称引发的信号混淆与内生劳动努力下降显著固化了该陷阱。本文的研究为通过质量导向型产业支持政策、差异化产权保护及结构性改革打破内卷提供理论支撑。

abstract: 中央八项规定自上而下重塑了政商交往方式,对整饬政治风气和构建优良社会风尚具有重要意义。本文从微观视角出发,探究中央八项规定对民营部门善饮酒者职业发展的影响。研究发现,八项规定显著降低了民营部门善饮酒者的职业晋升概率。进一步研究表明,八项规定规范了政商间非正式沟通渠道,削弱了饮酒技能的市场回报。政策效应在酒桌文化浓、政府补助依赖度高、市场化程度高的区域更加显著。本研究为理解制度环境对人力资本作用的影响提供了微观证据,证实了制度环境变化会使特定技能的市场价值因供需关系改变而重新定价。

abstract: 理清增值税纳税人身份选择行为的微观形成机理,对于提高税收征管效率、维护企业税负公平以及保障增值税收入稳定增长等具有重要意义。本文采用聚束（bunching）方法研究增值税纳税人身份选择行为对企业增值税实际税负的影响,并对小规模纳税人“拒绝长大”的形成原因及实现路径进行讨论。研究表明,相对于转为一般纳税人的小规模纳税人而言,实施纳税身份筹划的小规模纳税人的增值税实际税负较低。进一步研究发现,小规模纳税人为保持现有纳税身份会对应税销售额进行调整,表现为小规模纳税人的产品平均销售价格显著下降、销售量明显减少、账税差异水平提高,即企业会利用降低销售价格、减少销售量和实施财务筹划等方式使其应税销售额符合小规模纳税人认定标准。本文研究结论表明,政府应优化增值税纳税人身份转换制度设计,提高税收征管的效能和精准性,缩小不同类型企业间税负差异以增强经济发展的内生动力。

abstract: Inflationary shocks do not affect all workers equally. Comparing men and women, we document two facts. First, both demand- and supply-driven inflationary shocks widen the gender wage gap within industries and occupations. Because these shocks imply opposite business-cycle conditions, their common effect points to inflation as the relevant force. Second, women and men perceive the same inflationary shocks as having different labor-market consequences: women expect conditions to worsen, while men expect them to improve. This asymmetry creates an expectations channel linking inflation to unequal wage growth. We formalize this channel in a New Keynesian search-and-matching model with male and female workers, imperfect information, and gender-specific ambiguity attitudes. Common macroeconomic signals lead ambiguity-averse women to place greater weight on adverse supply-driven states. For inflationary signals, this lowers their perceived outside options and wage demands relative to men
abstract_zh: 通胀冲击对不同劳动者的影响并不均等。通过对比男性和女性，我们揭示了两项事实。其一，无论是需求驱动型还是供给驱动型的通胀冲击，都会在行业和职业内部扩大性别工资差距。由于这两类冲击对应截然不同的商业周期条件，其共同效应表明通胀本身才是关键作用力。其二，面对相同的通胀冲击，女性和男性对其劳动力市场后果的感知存在差异：女性预期就业状况将恶化，而男性则预期改善。这种认知不对称形成了一种将通胀与工资不平等增长联系起来的预期传导渠道。我们通过构建包含男女劳动者、不完全信息以及性别特异性模糊态度的新凯恩斯搜寻匹配模型，对这一渠道进行了形式化分析。共同的宏观经济信号使厌恶模糊性的女性更倾向于赋予不利供给驱动状态更高权重。对于通胀信号而言，这导致她们相较于男性降低了对外部选择权与工资诉求的预期值。
title: Divergent Perceptions, Divergent Pay: Inflation and the Gender Wage Gap
title_zh: 分歧认知，分歧薪酬：通货膨胀与性别工资差距

abstract: <jats:p>I document that the right tail of the firm size distribution systematically thickens with economic development. To rationalize this fact, I develop a parsimonious idea search model in which both aggregate growth and the firm size distribution are endogenously determined. The model features an asymptotic balanced growth path along which Gibrat's law holds at each date, and the right tail of the firm size distribution thickens monotonically toward Zipf's law. The model also implies that policies favoring large firms can improve welfare by better utilizing the diffusion externalities arising from idea search.</jats:p>
abstract_zh: 本文发现，企业规模分布的右尾随经济发展系统性增厚。为解释这一事实，我构建了一个简约的思想搜寻模型，其中总量增长与企业规模分布均为内生决定。该模型具有渐进平衡增长路径特征，在此路径上各期均满足吉布拉定律，且企业规模分布的右尾单调增厚直至趋近齐普夫定律。模型还表明，偏好大企业的政策可通过更充分利用思想搜寻产生的扩散外部性来提升社会福利。
title: Economic Growth and the Rise of Large Firms
title_zh: 经济增长与大型企业的崛起

abstract: <jats:p>Unlike gender or race, class background is rarely a focus of research on career progression, or of DEI efforts in elite occupations. Should it be? In this paper, we document a large class gap in career progression in one occupation—U.S. tenure‐track academia—using parental education to proxy for class background. First‐generation college graduates are 10% less likely to be tenured at an R1, are tenured at institutions ranked 11% lower, earn 3% less, and report 5% lower job satisfaction, than their former PhD classmates (from the same institution and field) with a parent with a non‐PhD graduate degree. Neither selection out of academia nor different preferences explain this gap; differential research productivity also plays little role. Instead, likely drivers are differences in cultural and social capital. We also find a class gap in career progression for PhDs who work in industry, suggesting this phenomenon generalizes outside academia.</jats:p>
abstract_zh: 与性别或种族不同，阶级背景很少成为职业发展研究或精英职业领域多元化、公平与包容（DEI）举措的关注焦点。那么，它是否应该被重视？本文以美国终身教职制学术界这一职业为例，利用父母教育程度作为阶级背景的代理变量，揭示了职业发展中的显著阶级差距。与父母拥有非博士研究生学位的同届博士同学（来自同一院校和领域）相比，第一代大学毕业生在R1研究型大学获得终身教职的可能性低10%，其任职院校排名低11%，收入少3%，且工作满意度低5%。这一差距既非源于学术界的选择性退出，也非偏好差异所致；研究生产力的差异同样作用甚微。相反，文化资本和社会资本的差异是可能的驱动因素。此外，我们发现在产业界工作的博士群体中也存在职业发展的阶级差距，这表明该现象具有超越学术界的普遍性。
title: The Class Gap in Career Progression: Evidence From U.S. Academia
title_zh: 职业晋升中的阶级差距：来自美国学术界的证据

abstract:
<jats:p>
                    Evidence from the laboratory and the field has uncovered both underreaction and overreaction to new information. We provide new experimental evidence on the underlying mechanisms of under‐ and overreaction by comparing how people make inferences
                    <jats:italic>and</jats:italic>
                    revise forecasts in the same information environment. Participants underreact to signals when inferring about underlying states, but overreact to the same signals when revising forecasts about future outcomes—a phenomenon we term “the inference‐forecast gap.” We show that this gap is largely driven by different simplifying heuristics used in the two tasks. Additional treatments suggest that the choice of heuristics is affected by the similarity between statistics in the information environment and the statistic elicited by the belief‐updating problem.
                  </jats:p>
abstract_zh: 来自实验室和现场的证据揭示了人们对新信息既存在反应不足也存在反应过度。我们通过比较人们在相同信息环境下如何进行推断和修正预测，提供了关于反应不足与反应过度内在机制的新实验证据。参与者在推断潜在状态时对信号反应不足，但在修正对未来结果的预测时却对相同信号反应过度——我们将这一现象称为“推断-预测差距”。研究表明，这一差距主要由两项任务中使用的不同简化启发式策略驱动。额外实验处理表明，启发式策略的选择受到信息环境中的统计量与信念更新问题所引发的统计量之间相似性的影响。
title: The Inference‐Forecast Gap in Belief Updating
title_zh: 信念更新中的推断-预测差距

abstract: <jats:p>This paper explores the impact of information design on the auctioneer's revenue in the U.S. offshore oil/gas lease auctions where, post‐auction, the winner decides whether to explore the auctioned tract and must pay the government a royalty on its production value. I first document that there is a positive correlation between the exploration rate and publicly observed losing bids. This suggests that the winning bidder uses the rivals' bids to infer their private information about the tract's potential. I then characterize the equilibrium bidding strategy when the auctioneer designs and commits to how to reveal information on losing bids to the winning bidder. Counterfactual exercises reveal that alternative bid disclosure policies significantly improve auctioneer revenue.</jats:p>
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了信息设计对美国海上油气租赁拍卖中拍卖方收益的影响。在拍卖结束后，中标者需决定是否对拍卖地块进行勘探，并须按其生产价值向政府支付特许权使用费。我首先发现，勘探率与公开观察到的未中标报价之间存在正相关关系。这表明，中标者利用竞争对手的报价来推断其关于地块潜力的私人信息。随后，我刻画了当拍卖方设计并承诺如何向中标者披露未中标报价信息时的均衡投标策略。反事实分析表明，替代性的报价披露政策能够显著提高拍卖方收益。
title: Information Design in Common Value Auction With Moral Hazard: Application to OCS Leasing Auctions
title_zh: 道德风险下的共同价值拍卖信息设计：在OCS租赁拍卖中的应用

abstract:
<jats:p>
                    The U.S. Supreme Court's 2010 decision in
                    <jats:italic>Citizens United v. Federal Election Commission</jats:italic>
                    deregulated campaign finance, enabling the rise of a new political action committee (the Super PAC) with broad freedom to raise and spend money. This led to an unprecedented surge in spending in primary and general elections. To evaluate the impact of Super PACs, I estimate a multistage model of political competition using data from U.S. Congressional elections between 2010 and 2020. I find that Super PAC spending by both sides prompts offsetting responses, resulting in limited net equilibrium effects. However, by amplifying the role of donors, Super PACs still have the potential to reshape the electoral landscape.
                  </jats:p>
abstract_zh: 美国最高法院2010年就"联合公民诉联邦选举委员会案"作出的裁决放松了对竞选资金的监管，催生了一种新型政治行动委员会（超级政治行动委员会），使其在筹款和支出方面拥有广泛自由。这导致初选和大选中的支出出现前所未有的激增。为评估超级政治行动委员会的影响，我利用2010年至2020年美国国会选举数据，估计了一个多阶段政治竞争模型。研究发现，双方超级政治行动委员会的支出会引发对冲性反应，导致均衡效应有限。然而，通过放大捐赠者的作用，超级政治行动委员会仍有可能重塑选举格局。
title: The Equilibrium Effects of Campaign Finance Deregulation on U.S. Elections
title_zh: 竞选财务放松管制对美国选举的均衡效应

abstract: <jats:p>We consider a dynamic buyer–seller interaction. Instead of the buyer's valuation, it is the frequency with which he needs to trade that is the buyer's private information. The difference matters. With commitment, full surplus extraction is possible, for instance via limited‐time offers. Without commitment, ratcheting is mitigated, as not buying is not necessarily a sign of strength. Because time is informative, the seller learns and may adjust her behavior over time. When finding a suitable alternative seller is easy, she starts with a pooling offer before permanently switching to a screening offer. When finding a suitable alternative seller takes time, she starts with a pooling offer before occasionally experimenting with separating offers.</jats:p>
abstract_zh: 我们研究了一种动态的买卖双方互动关系。与买方估值不同，买方需要交易的频率才是其私人信息。这一差异至关重要。在有承诺的情况下，完全剩余提取是可能的，例如通过限时报价。在没有承诺的情况下，棘轮效应得到缓解，因为不购买并不一定意味着买方处于强势地位。由于时间具有信息价值，卖方会随着时间推移学习并可能调整其行为。当寻找合适的替代卖方较为容易时，她会先提出混合报价，然后永久转向筛选报价。当寻找合适的替代卖方需要时间时，她会先提出混合报价，然后偶尔尝试分离报价。
title: Dynamic Screening of Buyers With Heterogeneous Purchase Frequency
title_zh: 异质性购买频率下买家的动态筛选

abstract: <jats:p>Customs data reveal the heterogeneity and granularity of relationships among buyers and sellers, showing how more exports to a destination break down into more firms selling there and more buyers per exporter. We develop a quantitative general equilibrium model of firm‐to‐firm matching that builds on this insight to separate the roles of iceberg costs and matching frictions in gravity. In the cross section, we find matching frictions as important as iceberg costs in impeding trade, and more sensitive to distance. Because domestic and imported intermediates compete directly with labor in performing production tasks, our model also fits the heterogeneity of labor shares across French producers. Applying the framework to the 2004 expansion of the European Union, reduced iceberg costs and reduced matching frictions contributed equally to the increase in French exports to the new members. While workers benefited overall, those competing most directly with imports gained less, even losing in some countries entering the EU.</jats:p>
abstract_zh: 海关数据揭示了买卖双方关系的异质性和颗粒度，显示对某一目的地的出口增长如何分解为更多企业在该地销售以及每个出口商拥有更多买家。我们构建了一个企业间匹配的量化一般均衡模型，基于这一洞察，将冰山成本与匹配摩擦在引力模型中的作用分离开来。在横截面分析中，我们发现匹配摩擦在阻碍贸易方面与冰山成本同等重要，且对距离更为敏感。由于国内和进口中间品在生产任务中直接与劳动力竞争，我们的模型也拟合了法国各企业劳动份额的异质性。将该框架应用于2004年欧盟扩张，冰山成本的降低与匹配摩擦的减少对法国向新成员国出口增长的贡献相当。尽管工人整体受益，但与进口竞争最直接的工人获益较少，甚至在部分加入欧盟的国家中遭受损失。
title: Firm‐to‐Firm Trade: Imports, Exports, and the Labor Market
title_zh: 企业间贸易：进口、出口与劳动力市场

abstract: <jats:p>We consider impulse response inference in a locally misspecified vector autoregression (VAR) model. The conventional local projection (LP) confidence interval has correct coverage even when the misspecification is so large that it can be detected with probability approaching 1. This result follows from a “double robustness” property analogous to that of popular partially linear regression estimators. By contrast, the conventional VAR confidence interval with short‐to‐moderate lag length can severely undercover for misspecification that is small, difficult to detect statistically, and cannot be ruled out based on economic theory. The VAR confidence interval has robust coverage if, and only if, the lag length is so large that the interval is as wide as the LP interval.</jats:p>
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在局部误设定的向量自回归（VAR）模型中脉冲响应推断的问题。传统的局部投影（LP）置信区间即使在误设定程度大到能以趋近于1的概率被检测到时，仍能保持正确的覆盖率。这一结果源于一种与流行的部分线性回归估计量相似的“双重稳健性”性质。相比之下，采用短至中等滞后长度的传统VAR置信区间，在面对较小、难以从统计上检测且无法基于经济理论排除的误设定时，可能严重低估覆盖率。VAR置信区间只有在滞后长度足够大，使其区间宽度与LP区间相当时，才具有稳健的覆盖率。
title: Double Robustness of Local Projections and Some Unpleasant VARithmetic
title_zh: 局部投影的双重稳健性与一些令人不快的VAR算术

abstract: <jats:p>We construct a dynamic integrated assessment model of climate and the economy with very high geographic resolution. Migration is free within, but not allowed across, countries. The model parameterization uses a wealth of data, including the distribution of output, population, energy sources and use, and estimates of the local damages from climate change. It implies very large geographic dispersion in damages from warming. We conduct three kinds of policy experiments. In one, we note that a modest, uniform carbon tax limits global warming and damages around the world substantially. In a second experiment, we let the poorest countries not tax carbon, while the rest compensate by setting higher taxes; the efficiency losses are large. In a final experiment, we find that fast green technology growth alone is a poor substitute for carbon taxes, whether globally available or not.</jats:p>
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个具有极高地理分辨率的动态气候与经济综合评估模型。模型设定中，人口可在国家内部自由迁移，但禁止跨国流动。模型参数化过程运用了丰富的数据集，包括产出分布、人口分布、能源来源与使用情况，以及气候变化对各地造成的损失估算。该模型揭示了全球变暖损失在地理分布上的巨大差异性。我们开展了三类政策实验：其一，适度的统一碳税能够显著抑制全球变暖并大幅降低全球损失；其二，若允许最贫困国家免征碳税，而其他国家通过提高税率进行补偿，则会产生巨大的效率损失；其三，我们发现，无论绿色技术是否实现全球普及，仅靠其快速增长都无法有效替代碳税政策。
title: Walras–Bowley Lecture: Climate Policy in the Wide World
title_zh: 瓦尔拉斯-鲍利讲座：广阔世界中的气候政策

abstract: <jats:p>Personalizing policies can theoretically increase their effectiveness. However, personalization is difficult when individual types are unobservable and the preferences of policymakers and individuals are not aligned, which could cause individuals to misreport their type. Mechanism design offers a strategy to overcome this issue: offer an “incentive‐compatible” menu of policy choices designed to induce participants to select the variant intended for their type. Using a field experiment that personalized incentives for exercise among 6,800 adults with diabetes and hypertension in urban India, we show that personalizing with an incentive‐compatible choice menu substantially improves program performance, increasing the treatment effect of incentives on exercise by 80% without increasing incentive costs relative to a one‐size‐fits‐all benchmark. Offering choice achieves similar performance to personalizing with an extensive set of observable variables, but without the same data requirements.</jats:p>
abstract_zh: 个性化政策在理论上可以提升其有效性。然而，当个体类型不可观测，且政策制定者与个体的偏好不一致时，个性化难以实现，因为这可能导致个体虚报其类型。机制设计提供了一种解决该问题的策略：提供一份“激励相容”的政策选择菜单，旨在引导参与者选择针对其类型设计的方案。通过在印度城市地区对6800名患有糖尿病和高血压的成年人进行一项实地实验，我们证明，采用激励相容的选择菜单进行个性化激励，能显著提升项目绩效：与一刀切的基准方案相比，在不增加激励成本的情况下，将激励对锻炼的处理效应提高了80%。提供选择菜单所达到的效果，与利用大量可观测变量进行个性化处理的效果相当，但无需相同的数据要求。
title: Mechanism Design for Personalized Policy: A Field Experiment Incentivizing Exercise
title_zh: 个性化政策的机制设计：一项激励运动的实地实验

abstract: <jats:p>This paper develops a macroeconomic model that combines an incomplete‐markets overlapping‐generations economy with a job ladder featuring sequential wage bargaining, endogenous search effort of employed and non‐employed workers, and differences in match quality. With these ingredients, our model provides a joint microfoundation for the three main inputs in aggregate production: capital, employment, and labor efficiency. The calibrated model offers a good fit to the empirical age profiles of search activity, job‐finding rates, wages, and savings. We use the model to analyze the impact of tax and transfer policies for labor market dynamics and aggregate economic activity via capital, employment, and labor efficiency channels. Lower unemployment benefits and a less progressive tax schedule bring about welfare losses for a newborn worker which are mainly driven by higher consumption risk and costlier search effort; both policies have differential effects along the age, income, and wealth dimensions.</jats:p>
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个宏观经济学模型，该模型将不完全市场的世代交叠经济与包含序贯工资谈判、就业与非就业工人内生搜寻努力以及匹配质量差异的工作阶梯相结合。基于这些要素，我们的模型为总生产中的三个主要投入——资本、就业和劳动效率——提供了统一的微观基础。校准后的模型较好地拟合了搜寻活动、工作找到率、工资和储蓄的年龄分布经验特征。我们利用该模型分析税收与转移支付政策通过资本、就业和劳动效率渠道对劳动力市场动态及总体经济活动的影响。降低失业救济金和减少税收累进性会给新生工人带来福利损失，这主要源于更高的消费风险和更昂贵的搜寻努力；这两种政策在年龄、收入和财富维度上具有差异化效应。
title: Job Ladder and Wealth Dynamics in General Equilibrium
title_zh: 一般均衡中的职业阶梯与财富动态

abstract: <jats:p>We study instrumental variables models characterized by: (i) Unobserved heterogeneity consisting of potential outcomes and response types that describe how the instrument determines treatment choice; (ii) Conditional independence of the instrument and the unobserved heterogeneity; and (iii) Convex restrictions on the distribution of unobserved heterogeneity. We show certain causal parameters are identified in these models if and only if a version of the kappa of Abadie (2003) exists. Our identification results are constructive in yielding estimating moment conditions. Focusing on a leading special case, we develop asymptotically normal estimators based on a doubly robust version of these moment conditions.</jats:p>
abstract_zh: 我们研究具有以下特征的工具变量模型：（i）未观测异质性由潜在结果和描述工具如何决定处理选择的响应类型构成；（ii）工具与未观测异质性条件独立；（iii）未观测异质性分布满足凸性约束。我们证明，当且仅当Abadie（2003）的kappa统计量存在时，这些模型中的某些因果参数可被识别。我们的识别结果是建设性的，能够导出估计矩条件。聚焦于一个主要特例，我们基于这些矩条件的双重稳健版本开发了渐近正态估计量。
title: Identification in Instrumental Variables Models: The Central Role of Abadie's Kappa
title_zh: 工具变量模型中的识别：Abadie's Kappa的核心作用

abstract: “房票”安置作为地方政府探索的创新性拆迁补偿模式,近年来应用范围持续扩大。本文基于罗伊选择模型和微观数据,系统分析了“房票”安置模式在存量住房去库存和优化财政支出方面的作用,并探讨了“房票”安置中最优补贴率的确定及其福利效应。研究表明,“房票”安置平均带来了28 199元的家庭福利改进,等价于样本家庭年平均收入的37.38%;同时,“房票”政策通过引导拆迁居民购房选择,使存量住房库存下降,节约了政府的拆迁建设成本。测算结果显示,当前补贴率下公共资金边际绩效在0.99~4.58范围内,表明房票安置补贴有显著的社会净收益。最后,本文对最优“房票”补贴率的分析显示,在综合考虑拆迁家庭福利改进和财政补贴成本的情况下,“房票”补贴率还有进一步提升空间。

abstract: 本文分析了我国权威型教养方式背后的社会经济动因,其与社会教育回报率和地区收入差距有直接联系。本文利用2005年人口抽样调查和多项微观调查数据,研究发现父母在26-40岁经历的教育回报率每提高1个百分点,其采取权威型教养方式的概率将提高1.21个百分点。地区收入差距会进一步扩大教育回报率对教养方式选择的影响,因为在收入差距越大的地区,父母越有动力严格要求子女,提高其教育水平,从而实现社会经济地位向上流动。机制分析表明,高教育回报率会增强父母对教育价值的认同和对子女的学历期望。本文还分析了权威型教养方式的积极影响及其可能产生的成本。本研究为理解家庭养育中的“内卷”行为提供了经济学解释。

abstract: Using a unique matched bank-employer-employee administrative dataset for Italy, we construct an exogenous firm-level measure of exposure to the credit shock during the Global Financial Crisis, based on pre-crisis firm-bank relationships. We track outcomes for firms and workers up to 11 years after the shock. More exposed firms experience persistently lower growth in bank credit, which in turn leads to weaker investment and employment dynamics due to capital-labor complementarity. More capital-intensive firms and their workers suffer the most. Displaced workers reallocate primarily to less capital-intensive firms, incurring persistent losses in labor earnings.
abstract_zh: 利用意大利独特的银行-雇主-雇员匹配行政数据集，我们基于危机前的企业-银行关系，构建了全球金融危机期间企业层面信贷冲击暴露度的外生衡量指标。我们追踪了冲击发生后长达11年的企业与工人结果。信贷暴露度更高的企业持续面临更低的银行信贷增长，进而因资本-劳动互补性导致投资与就业动态疲弱。资本密集度更高的企业及其工人遭受的损失最为严重。被解雇的工人主要重新配置到资本密集度较低的企业，并承受持久的劳动收入损失。
title: The Long-Term Earnings' Effects of a Credit Market Disruption
title_zh: 信贷市场中断对长期收入的影响

abstract: Americans rarely marry outside their race or class group, a pattern with well-documented implications for inequality and intergenerational mobility. Limited exposure may partly explain these low intergroup marriage rates. We instrument for exposure using variation in childhood neighborhoods based on whether other race and class groups had more opposite-sex children of similar age. Exposure increases interclass (high- and low-parent-income) marriage but has no detectable effect on interracial (White and Black) marriage. A spatial marriage model predicts that residential segregation—one of many forms of exposure—accounts for more than one third of marital sorting by class but less than 5 percent by race.
abstract_zh: 美国人很少跨种族或跨阶层通婚，这一模式对不平等和代际流动性具有充分论证的影响。有限的接触机会可能部分解释了这些低群体间通婚率。我们利用童年居住社区的差异——基于其他种族和阶层群体中是否有更多同龄异性儿童——作为接触机会的工具变量。接触机会增加了跨阶层（高收入与低收入父母家庭）通婚，但对跨种族（白人与黑人）通婚未产生可检测的影响。空间婚姻模型预测，居住隔离（接触机会的多种形式之一）解释了超过三分之一的阶层婚姻匹配，但仅解释了不到5%的种族婚姻匹配。
title: Who Marries Whom? The Role of Segregation by Race and Class
title_zh: 谁与谁结婚？种族与阶级隔离的作用

abstract: This paper studies the economic impacts of carbon pricing. Exploiting institutional features of the European carbon market and high-frequency data, I identify carbon policy shocks and trace their dynamic effects. A restrictive carbon policy shock raises energy prices, reduces emissions, spurs green innovation, but decreases economic activity—disproportionately burdening poorer households. Not only are the poor more affected because of their higher energy spending, but they also experience larger income losses. These indirect, general-equilibrium effects via income and employment play an important role in the transmission of carbon pricing policies, accounting for about two-thirds of the aggregate consumption response.
abstract_zh: 本文研究碳定价的经济影响。利用欧洲碳市场的制度特征与高频数据，我识别出碳政策冲击并追踪其动态效应。限制性碳政策冲击推高能源价格、减少排放、刺激绿色创新，但会抑制经济活动——且对贫困家庭造成不成比例的负担。贫困家庭不仅因能源支出占比更高而受到更大影响，其收入损失也更为显著。这些通过收入与就业渠道传导的间接一般均衡效应，在碳定价政策的传导机制中发挥重要作用，约占总体消费反应的三分之二。
title: The Unequal Economic Consequences of Carbon Pricing
title_zh: 碳定价的不平等经济后果

abstract: How do majority groups respond to narrowing inequality in racially polarized environments? We study this by examining the Freedmen’s Bureau, an agency created after the US Civil War to aid former slaves and launch institutional reform in the South. Using new historical records and an event-study approach, we estimate the Bureau’s impact on political, social, and economic outcomes. Vote shares for Democrats, the party that previously championed slavery and opposed Black civil rights, initially eroded in Bureau counties, but these impacts faded as federal oversight weakened. Racial backlash emerged rapidly and persisted, suggesting White majorities sought to offset Black progress.
abstract_zh: 在种族极化环境中，多数群体如何应对日益缩小的不平等？我们通过研究美国内战后为援助前奴隶并在南方推行制度改革而设立的“自由民局”来探讨这一问题。利用新历史记录和事件研究方法，我们估算了该局对政治、社会和经济结果的影响。在自由民局覆盖的县，民主党（此前支持奴隶制并反对黑人公民权利的政党）的得票率最初有所下降，但随着联邦监督的减弱，这些影响逐渐消失。种族反弹迅速出现并持续存在，表明白人多数群体试图抵消黑人的进步。
title: Inequality and Racial Backlash: Evidence from the Reconstruction Era and the Freedmen’s Bureau
title_zh: 不平等与种族反弹：来自重建时期与自由民局的证据

abstract: Durables represent a large share of households’ marginal propensity to spend (MPX). We develop a quantitative model of spending that takes durables into account and matches a rich set of empirical regularities simultaneously. Scaling the response of non-durables provides a poor approximation of the MPX on durables when it comes to its distribution in the population, its persistence over time, and its cyclicality. As an application, we study how the MPX varies with the size of stimulus checks and find that it declines more slowly compared to a model of purely non-durable spending.
abstract_zh: 耐用品在家庭边际消费倾向（MPX）中占据较大份额。我们构建了一个考虑耐用品的定量支出模型，该模型同时匹配了丰富的经验规律。在人口分布、时间持续性及周期性方面，仅通过非耐用品反应的缩放来近似耐用品的MPX效果不佳。作为应用，我们研究了MPX如何随刺激支票金额变化，发现其下降速度比纯非耐用品支出模型更慢。
title: Durables and the Marginal Propensity to Spend
title_zh: 耐用品与边际消费倾向

abstract: This paper studies how collective bargaining affects wages and amenities. By merging collective bargaining agreements (CBAs) to linked employer-employee data in Brazil, I combine rich contracted amenities with wage information. I implement a difference-in-difference strategy that exploits a court ruling enforcing CBA continuation (i.e., ultractivity) to estimate the effects of union bargaining power. Strengthening unions raises wages and amenities without reducing employment—increasing retention despite some labor-labor substitution. A revealed preference approach shows that amenities account for 45% of total compensation gains. These findings suggest that collective bargaining can offset monopsony power, but employers retain the right-tomanage workforce composition.
abstract_zh: 本文研究集体谈判如何影响工资与福利。通过将集体谈判协议与巴西雇主-雇员关联数据匹配，我整合了丰富的合同约定福利与工资信息。采用双重差分策略，利用法院关于强制延续集体谈判协议（即超期效力）的裁决，估计工会谈判力量的影响。强化工会力量在未减少就业的情况下提高了工资与福利——尽管存在部分劳动力替代效应，但员工留存率有所提升。基于显示性偏好方法的研究表明，福利占薪酬总增长的45%。这些发现表明，集体谈判可抵消买方垄断势力，但雇主仍保留管理劳动力构成的权利。
title: Union Bargaining Power and the Amenity-Wage Tradeoff
title_zh: 工会谈判力与舒适性-工资权衡

abstract: We establish a link between labor scarcity and the adoption of labor-saving technology in industrializing England. During the Napoleonic Wars, more than 10 percent of the male population served in the armed forces. Where recruitment was heavy, more machines economizing on labor were adopted. Naval recruitment, instrumented by warships’ coastal access, provides exogenous variation in labor scarcity and suggests that the link between labor shortages and adoption is causal. Where mechanical skills were abundant, the impact of labor scarcity on adoption appears to be larger.
abstract_zh: 我们建立了劳动力稀缺性与工业化英格兰采用节省劳动力技术之间的联系。在拿破仑战争期间，超过10%的男性人口在武装部队服役。在征兵力度较大的地区，更多节省劳动力的机器被采用。以军舰沿海通道为工具变量的海军征兵，提供了劳动力稀缺性的外生变化，表明劳动力短缺与采用之间存在因果关系。在机械技能丰富的地区，劳动力稀缺性对技术采用的影响似乎更大。
title: Fighting for Growth: Labor Scarcity and Technological Progress During the British Industrial Revolution
title_zh: 为增长而战：英国工业革命时期的劳动力稀缺与技术进步

abstract: We study residential segregation and access to public services across 1.5 million urban and rural neighborhoods in India. Muslim and Scheduled Caste segregation in India is high by global standards, and only slightly lower than Black-White segregation in the United States. Within cities, public facilities and infrastructure are systematically less available in Muslim and Scheduled Caste neighborhoods. Nearly all regressive allocation is across neighborhoods within cities—at the most informal and least studied form of government. These inequalities are not visible in the aggregate data typically used for research and policy.
abstract_zh: 本研究考察了印度150万个城乡社区中的居住隔离与公共服务获取情况。按全球标准衡量，印度穆斯林与表列种姓的居住隔离程度较高，仅略低于美国的黑白种族隔离。在城市内部，穆斯林与表列种姓社区的公共设施和基础设施系统性匮乏。几乎所有倒退性资源分配都发生在城市内部的社区之间——这属于最非正式且研究最少的政府层级。这些不平等现象在通常用于研究与政策制定的汇总数据中无法显现。
title: Residential Segregation and Unequal Access to Local Public Services in India: Evidence from 1.5 Million Neighborhoods
title_zh: 印度居住隔离与地方公共服务获取不平等：来自150万邻里的证据
